sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *dejar de* + infinitive from B1 Unit 12. It says that something stopped happening or stopped being true. Here you use it for booms that ended: *El guano dejó de ser el gran negocio del Perú.*

items.spanish: En los años 1870, el guano dejó de ser el gran negocio del Perú.
items.english: In the 1870s, guano stopped being Peru's big business.

items.spanish: En 1876 el Estado peruano dejó de pagar la deuda.
items.english: In 1876 the Peruvian state stopped paying its debt.

items.spanish: El salitre de Chile dejó de ser tan importante.
items.english: Chilean saltpetre stopped being so important.

sections.content: Always keep *de*: *dejó de ser*, never *dejó ser*. After *dejar de* comes an infinitive (*ser*, *pagar*), not a noun. *Dejar* + noun means something else: *dejó el negocio* (he left the business).
